title: Requests and account completion cross a replacement session
reproduction: Actual loopback HTTP: pause openUrl for an export under A, replace session with B, release; Authorization uses B. Separately pause revoke A response, recover B through HTTP, release revoke; B session becomes null.
impact: An operation may run against a different account from its original intent, or remove a newly recovered credential.
additional_reproduction: Three delayed secure-storage operations restore/write A over recovered B or delete B credential; two stale A ownership responses/errors erase B already-verified projection.
repair: Captured session generation and account intent; serialized secure credential writes/deletes with current-session rewrite; generation/seed guards on ownership success and error.

title: Consent ordering and telemetry account isolation are missing
reproduction: Delay opt-in, complete later opt-out, then deliver opt-in; both native manager and platform buffer become enabled. Queue A activity, replace session with B, flush; sendTelemetry executes under B.
impact: Local refusal can be overridden and old-account events can be submitted under another account. Gameplay reporting is not yet wired; this is a public platform-client and native preference defect.
additional_reproduction: Native and buffer opt-out lose at remote commit when old opt-in is delayed; latest desired remote state must also end disabled.
repair: Session-bound queue, intent checks, serialized remote consent operations, immediate local refusal, durable pending withdrawal, and serialized privacy writes.

title: Stale purchase verification completes and clears its retry after identity changes
reproduction: Delay purchased verification under A and harbor seed X, change account or harbor, release response; native store complete is called and UI marks verified although ownership projection correctly rejects the stale result.
impact: Current UI falsely reports delivery and retry context is discarded. No wrong-account paid cosmetic grant occurred.
repair: Capture session identity, generation and harbor seed; recheck before SDK completion and after asynchronous completion; retain retry when context changes.

title: A free briefing syncs to an account chosen during the local save
reproduction: Pause onPersist after awarding briefing under A, replace session with B, release save; claimSupport executes for B.
impact: The new account may consume the wrong shared daily slot. The local free token remains valid.
repair: Capture account, generation and harbor seed before local delivery; sync only after durable save and matching context.
